## History

Roger Pye is a member of the [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes) family, whose relative Joshua accidentally painted the town hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. This mistake caused the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to gather in despair over the blunder. However, the incident ultimately caused public sympathy to turn in favor of the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and against Roger and his family.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +23 more_
